Welcome to LPE Drainage

LPE Drainage provides reliable, professional drainage services for homes, landlords and businesses. We handle everything from blocked drains and high-pressure jetting to installing new drainage, soakaways and French drains.

We also solve waterlogged gardens and standing water, and carry out boiler and electrical work, so you can use one trusted team for the whole job.

Whether it's an emergency or planned work, give us a call to talk it through.

Our services

Much more than just drainage

One call covers it, from unblocking to full installations.

Blocked drains

Sinks, toilets, showers and outside drains unblocked quickly and cleanly.

Drain jetting

High-pressure water jetting to clear grease, silt, scale and roots from the full pipe.

New drainage

New drain runs and connections for extensions, renovations and new builds.

Soakaways

New soakaways installed and failing ones cleared or replaced to stop flooding.

Garden water solutions

Waterlogged lawns, standing water and boggy borders drained and sorted.

French drains

Gravel-filled French drains to divert groundwater away from your property.

Boilers

Boiler repairs, servicing and replacements to keep your heating and hot water running.

Electrical

Electrical repairs, fault-finding and installations for homes and businesses.
